messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU memory surge detected on farm-3, model: redwood-rlhf-13B, action: automatic restart of container; severity: P1
ops-oncall: I'm on it, pulling logs now. Any immediate customer reports?
sara: seeing repeated CUDA OOM on prefill path for requests with >120k tokens. Container restarted twice in 6m. Suspect large prompt + kvcache growth.
dan: rolling a quick metric query for recent long-context traces. Also checking node-level OOM events.
ops-oncall: can we triage whether it's prefill or generation? if prefill, disable prefix caching for this model temporarily.
sara: confirmed prefill. trace id 0x8f3c shows allocate spike at prefill. kvcache went from 1.2GB -> 6.5GB due to repeated long prompts.
infra-alerts: node farm-3-gpu12 reported 'GPU driver reset' at 2026-03-17T01:22:33Z
ops-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) disable kv prefix cache for redwood-rlhf-13B on farm-3; 2) switch traffic for heavy-context customers to cpu-backed fallback pool; 3) scale up hotpool with smaller-batch instances.
sara: pushing config change to disable prefix cache for this model in region-us-west now. patch id: cfg-20260317-01
ops-oncall: applying routing rule to divert requests with context-length > 50k to low-memory variant.
emma-cs: any customer impact? a support ticket came in about stream disconnects for a finance customer.
dan: preliminary impact: ~0.8% of requests in last 30m hit 500/internal errors, concentrated on two customers with long contexts.
emma-cs: drafting customer note: 'We observed intermittent model restarts affecting long-context requests; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with timeline.'
ops-oncall: restarting affected containers after cache disable... doing one node at a time.
sara: after cache disabled, memory profile is stabilized. no OOMs in last 6 mins on the trial container.
dan: continuing to monitor. will keep an eye on disk swap/noisy neighbor.
ops-oncall: created follow-up runbook task: investigate why kvcache growth wasn't bounded; tagging eng-runtime.
sara: filing an internal postmortem ticket with traces and reproducer steps. ticket: PM-2026-0317-mlmem
ops-oncall: leaving a note for oncall rotation: if reoccurs, escalate to eng-runtime & infra immediately and enable coldmodel fallback.
emma-cs: sent interim update to affected customers.
ops-oncall: closing pager, will hand off to morning rotation for follow-up. thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident closed by ops-oncall (duration ~48m)
